curated.by: Claude, from social-proof-carousel.code.evidence.json and the Figma metadata of 12102:175374 / 8278:190566

description: Full-bleed slider of QuoteCards: the active slide centered with equal peeks of its neighbours, knockout IconButton arrows, native toggle-button pagination. No autoplay.

figma.notes: There is no carousel component set: the section frame composes .slide-left/.slide-active/.slide-right (.QuoteCard instances), a Global / Carousel nav instance on each side, an IconButton — v2, and three pagination ellipses. Axes below are therefore layer-level, not variant properties.

props.name: slides

figma.notes: three .QuoteCard instances in the frame; the design shows exactly three

props.notes: Each entry is a QuoteCard props object; the Homepage carries one verified testimonial and hides inactive controls (data-single).

props.name: activeIndex
props.notes: Initial position; runtime state after mount.

code.mechanism: controller sets data-state, aria-hidden and inert per slide

states.name: single

code.mechanism: hides arrows and pagination when fewer than two slides

states.notes: Homepage state; the design always shows three slides.

code.mechanism: controller: peek 11.46% ≥1600px, 8.6% below, 16px under 600px; 8px gaps; active slide at peek + gap

slot.name: slide
slot.notes: One QuoteCard per slide; inactive slides are inert.

slot.name: control
slot.notes: IconButton style=knockout size=lg, arrow-left / arrow-right, aria-label Previous slide / Next slide. Figma shows both a Global / Carousel instance and IconButton — v2 (see decisions).

nav.notes: 40px from each edge (Figma Nav items: 40 inset); mobile drops to the bottom edge.

dot.notes: Active dot: content/knockout, scale 1.25. Bindings taken from the .QuoteCard DotPagination instance (dot-1 active content/knockout; dot-2..5 transparent/white/64; radius/round; height spacing/xs).

keyboard.action: Previous slide except inside editable fields
Next slide except inside editable fields

notes: No autoplay. Transform transition is 500 ms and disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.
Inactive slides are inert and aria-hidden; pagination uses native toggle buttons, not incomplete tabs.
Call destroy() before replacing the DOM; it aborts event listeners and disconnects the ResizeObserver.

decisions.question: The section frame carries both a 'Global / Carousel' nav instance and an 'IconButton — v2'. Which is the arrow control of record?
decisions.decision: Code uses IconButton — v2 (knockout, lg), matching the icon-button bindings on the section (icon-button/background/knockout/default, content/knockout). Confirm and remove the Global / Carousel instances from the frame.

decisions.question: Pagination dots used raw white at 40% and pure white with nothing bound in the section frame.
decisions.decision: Bound to the tokens the .QuoteCard DotPagination instance binds: inactive transparent/white/64, active content/knockout, radius/round, size spacing/xs. Applied in social-proof-carousel.css 2026-09-17.

decisions.question: Arrow inset is 40px on desktop; spacing/2xl is 40px. Bind it?
decisions.decision: Bind to {s2a.spacing.2xl} in the spec transform; the value matches and the Figma inset is 40.
decisions.evidence: Figma Nav items x=40 / 512+40; social-proof-carousel.css lines 38–39.

decisions.question: Peek fractions and gaps per breakpoint.
decisions.decision: 1920: 220px (11.46%), 1440: 124px (8.6%), 375: 16px; 8px gaps; active slide at peek + gap so both neighbours peek equally.
decisions.evidence: Figma 12102:175386 Active Slide x=220; 8278:190566 Active Slide x=24 w=327; e2e + visual eval 2026-09-15.

decisions.question: Does the carousel autoplay?
decisions.decision: No. Arrow keys, arrows and dots only; transition 500ms on the shared curve, off under reduced motion.
decisions.evidence: spec a11y notes; motion eval contracts.
